newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon missile unit wins U.S. Army contracts.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon missile unit wins U.S. Army contracts.

text.p: The U.S. Army said Tuesday that it has awarded Raytheon Electronic Systems five contracts totaling $379 million.

It said the contracts are for $174 million to upgrade eight Mobility HAWK Assault Fire Units for Egypt; $96 million for supplies and services to improve Saudi Arabian HAWK missiles; $77 million for engineering and computer work for Patriot air defense systems in Japan, Kuwait, Israel, the Netherlands, Taiwan, Germany and Saudi Arabia; $26 million to support an Egyptian remanufacturing program, and $6 million for logistics engineering for the Egyptian program.
